collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE V: FAMILY DRAMA, FEUDS AND LEADERSHIP DISPUTES (LCE-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
All sorts of real-life drama suited to Isola: parents with opinions about who their children marry, arranged matches, inheritances, feuds between families, accusations, apologies that are not enough, and arguments about who should lead.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: A villager promised to help build a neighbor's hut and never came: confront them, or ask why.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) promised to help (friend) build (friend.his/her) new hut, and never showed up. Not once. (friend) built it alone, in the rain. Now (subject) is acting as if nothing happened. (friend) is still angry. What should (friend) do?

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (friend) tells (subject), loudly, how let down (friend.he/she) felt. (subject) goes pale, says (subject.he/she) is sorry, and walks away. Later, (friend) learns (subject)'s father had been very ill. (friend) does not know whether to be angry anymore.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (friend) asks, quietly, what happened. (subject) says only that it was a hard month, and that (subject.he/she) is sorry. (subject.He/she) does not explain further. (friend) does not push. The next week, (subject) arrives with a new door for the hut.
